name: Thomas J Wilson
current_role: Chair, President and CEO, The Allstate Corporation
profile: Thomas J. Wilson has led Allstate as president and CEO since 2007 and chairman since 2008, after serving as its CFO, head of Allstate Financial and president of Allstate Protection. Before joining Allstate from Sears in 1995 he worked in finance at Amoco and ran M&A at Dean Witter Reynolds. His wealth stems from Allstate equity.
interesting_fact: He is chairman of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation and a past chairman of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce board; he was also deputy chair of the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago.
deep_cut_fact: Born in St. Clair Shores, Michigan, he graduated from Lake Shore High School in 1975, and he co-founded the Get IN Chicago Foundation, focused on reducing youth violence.
notes: Public-company CEO; route via Allstate national media team. Also involved in Chicago civic initiatives (P33, OneTen).

name: John Andrew Doran
current_role: General Partner and Executive Committee member, TCV; Director, Sportradar Group AG
profile: Irish-born John Doran is a General Partner at growth-equity firm TCV, which he joined in 2012 and where he helped open the London office; he invests in consumer, fintech, enterprise software and AI (e.g. Revolut, Klarna, Celonis, Anthropic, Sportradar). Previously at Summit Partners and Morgan Stanley. His SEC-listed holdings reflect TCV's Sportradar stake.
interesting_fact: TCV lists him as involved with investments in Anthropic, Revolut, Klarna, Miro, Trade Republic and Sportradar; he holds an MBA and an economics BA from Harvard.
deep_cut_fact: Before investing he played on the men's ATP tennis tour and was a member of Ireland's Davis Cup team from 1996 to 2004; he is a current ATP Tour advisory board member.
notes: SEC holdings are indirect via TCV IX Sports Corp; wealth figure reflects fund holdings, not necessarily personal. Now based in Menlo Park per TCV bio.

name: Dhani Harrison
current_role: Musician, composer and singer-songwriter (solo artist; thenewno2)
profile: Dhani Harrison (b. 1978), son of George and Olivia Harrison, is an English-American musician and film/TV composer. He helped complete his father's final album Brainwashed (2002), formed thenewno2 in 2006, released solo albums In Parallel (2017) and Innerstanding, and scores films with partner Paul Hicks. Rich-list wealth is listed as inherited, shared with Olivia Harrison.
interesting_fact: He is named after the sixth and seventh notes of the Indian music scale, dha and ni; Dhani is also a North Indian raga.
deep_cut_fact: He studied industrial design and physics at Brown University and pursued a career as a car designer at McLaren Automotive before turning to music professionally.
notes: Musician, not an entrepreneur; wealth is inherited. Engineering/design background (Brown, McLaren) could be an angle.

name: Cheng Shangnan
current_role: Major shareholder (and former chairman), Changzhou NRB Corp. (Changzhou Guangyang Bearing)
profile: Cheng Shangnan is the long-time leader and a major shareholder (8.85% at end-2022) of Changzhou NRB, one of China's main automotive bearing suppliers, founded in 1987 as Changzhou Needle Bearing Factory. notes: Current title unclear: search snippets of MarkLines suggest he is now honorary chairman (~6.4% at end-2024) but I could not confirm on the page opened. Company profile: https://www.marklines.com/en/top500/changzhou-nrb
